Delete a Custom App
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/customapps/:id

Deletes a custom application by its unique identifier (id). If there is any scheduled report associated with the custom app ID then that particular report will also be deleted.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the custom application to delete.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
405
429
500

Custom application deleted successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
default
SCHEMA
message
string
id
int32
